title: Reproduce: Impact of Thyroid Function on the Prevalence and Mortality of Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Fatty Liver Disease
primary_question: Can an autonomous clinical-research agent reproduce the main analysis of PMID 36637992 (Impact of Thyroid Function on the Prevalence and Mortality of Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Fatty Liver Disease) using NHANES or its governed benchmark extract?
task: Reproduce the clinical-research workflow of PMID 36637992: Impact of Thyroid Function on the Prevalence and Mortality of Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Fatty Liver Disease. Primary endpoint: thyroid function, MAFLD prevalence, and mortality. Use NHANES or a locked benchmark extract derived from it. Report cohort construction, variables, statistical methods, the main reproduction result, sensitivity analyses, limitations, and one bounded new-discovery extension.
endpoint: thyroid function, MAFLD prevalence, and mortality
rediscovery_target: Recover the reported nonlinear risk pattern across thyroid function categories.
new_discovery_target: Assess whether risk is concentrated among older adults or those with baseline heart disease.

data.name: NHANES
data.description: CDC National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey public-use files.

evaluation.calibration_note: ClinicalRepBench Figure 2D calibration: 0-100 score, 50 approximates trained human paper-level reproduction; static metrics, format-only reports, and source-generic prose are capped by rubric critical checks.
